clips.title: The story
paras: Kerlonian Evershade struggles to stay awake on the road from Darkshore to Maestra's Post in Ashenvale. Newly awakened from a long sleep, he carries the Horn of Awakening and needs help against furbolgs and cultists along the way.

Kerlonian Evershade, a Druid of the Claw, has only recently awakened from sleep in the barrows. For millennia, the druids communed with wild spirits through the Emerald Dream. The Third War called them to wake, but centuries of hibernation leave Kerlonian struggling to stay conscious. He set out south from Darkshore to meet Liladris Moonriver in Ashenvale, yet exhaustion soon overtook him. Sudden naps leave him helpless along the wilds, so he depends on a brass Horn of Awakening and passing allies to keep moving.

The road from Darkshore into Ashenvale holds danger for Kerlonian. In Twilight Vale, corrupted Blackwood furbolgs stalk the roadway. Farther south in Ashenvale, members of the Dark Strand cult lie in ambush. Kerlonian may lie down wherever he stands when sleep takes him, so you need to keep watch and rouse him with the horn.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was on my way to Maestra's Post to meet Liladris Moonriver, but I decided to stop here and take a short nap. Ever since I awoke from the emerald dream, I have been so sleepy...
And I can't find my things anywhere! Would you mind helping me find them?
I understand that Maestra's Post is south of here, along the road in Ashenvale. I had come from that way...
Lastly, I may fall asleep so if you ever need to wake me, please use my horn. You'll find it in the chest here.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, I am so happy Kerlonian made it! And I'm sure I'll find him sleeping somewhere around here, won't I?
Thank you for showing him the way, friend.
